column1: # Stage S12 G13 — the agent context guards leave xtask: the `guards` module of the `ai` command
# group becomes the agent_context_guards crate under tools/commands, and its unit tests the
# crate's read guard tests. The crate root, the prelude, the error, the hook entry, the Bash rules,
# the output filter and the README files are written by hand; the `ai` group's command line and
# dispatch stay in the xtask binary. Paths name the tree before the moves.
# the guards module becomes the crate's read guard; its test file follows it
# the xtask dispatch's absolute paths into the moved module now name the crate
